proposed.title: A covering that names a column the file lacks is kept at open, and every bbox query then fails after the mint (A2-1 P0 k3)
proposed.summary: Filed on the 2026-09-29 sightings (state/directives/2026-09-29-a2-1-and-b-1-sightings.md, Fable's A2-1 (c): k3 stays out of A2-1, its own proposed node, graded by whether it breaks a stated clause). Evidence: state/drafts/a2-1-p0/covering-output.txt, k3 -- the file's geo metadata declares a covering whose struct is absent (no U+0000); the open succeeds with the covering kept, and a bbox viewport_query fails at its first stream item with an engine.query binder error, after the mint. Custodian's grading: S1 CANDIDATE on the viewport_query entry in SKP-V0's first section (a bbox request is validated against the dataset before any handle is minted, so NoCoveringBbox returns synchronously and never as a data-plane terminal frame). The case for S2, for Fable to weigh: the file's own metadata is malformed, and the failure is loud and typed. A2-1 drops a covering that is unusable because of U+0000 at open (its Amendment 12, OPEN (c)); this node would decide the same for a covering naming an absent column, where refusing the open instead is on engine/ADMISSION-PREREGISTRATION.md section 12d's human list.
